product.olivetti-m4-p133.summary: The 133 MHz M4-P in the Tin Box case of the EDO memory platform.
product.olivetti-m4-p133.history: Olivetti documented the professional M4-Pxx range on a platform shared with the PCS 51xx and 61xx.
product.olivetti-m4-p133.architecture: This version uses a PCI graphics card. The guide identifies the Matrox MGA Millennium and lists 2, 4 or 8 MB of video memory.
product.olivetti-m4-p133.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m4-p133.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m4-p133.service-guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 16
product.olivetti-m4-p133.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists 1.21.
